API unreachable
panels.description: Prometheus rule: ApiUnavailable. Clear means the rule is neither pending nor firing; it does not prove end-to-end correctness.

panels.title: High endpoint error ratio
panels.description: Prometheus rule: ApiErrors. Clear means the rule is neither pending nor firing; it does not prove end-to-end correctness.

panels.title: Redis operation failures
panels.description: Prometheus rule: RedisErrors. Clear means the rule is neither pending nor firing; it does not prove end-to-end correctness.

panels.title: ClickHouse consumer lag
panels.description: ClickHouseConsumerLag: a ClickHouse consumer group has topic lag above zero for 30 seconds. This rule covers the whole pipeline and is independent of the Endpoint filter.

options.content: **API overview** · Rates and latency use a rolling 1-minute window. Select an endpoint to investigate; cache and alert rules always cover the whole service. No traffic means latency and error ratio are undefined.

panels.title: API reachable

panels.title: Data delivery · all tables · independent of Endpoint filter

options.content: **Delivery latency** · Mean and p95 of streaming deliveries received in the last 5 minutes, including retries. Snapshots and missing or out-of-order timestamps are excluded. ClickHouse time is measured inside the ingestion MV; API visibility and cache delay are measured separately. These graphs do not include events still waiting upstream.

panels.title: Delivery metrics reachable
panels.description: Prometheus can query the ClickHouse delivery metrics view. This is independent of the API process.

panels.title: Deliveries · last 5 min
panels.description: All streaming deliveries received in raw, including retries; snapshot excluded. A zero count means no deliveries observed in this window, not proof of an idle source.

panels.title: Excluded latency samples · last 5 min
panels.description: Missing timestamps or negative stage delays. Nonzero values require checking metadata and clock synchronization.

panels.title: Source → Debezium
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute mean and p95 for each source table, in seconds. Missing lines mean no valid samples. These are delivery gauges; do not apply rate() or average p95 across tables.

panels.title: Debezium → ClickHouse
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute mean and p95 for each source table, in seconds. Missing lines mean no valid samples. These are delivery gauges; do not apply rate() or average p95 across tables.

panels.title: Source → ClickHouse
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute mean and p95 for each source table, in seconds. Missing lines mean no valid samples. These are delivery gauges; do not apply rate() or average p95 across tables.

panels.title: Requests by endpoint
panels.description: Selected business endpoints. Health checks and metric scrapes are excluded.

panels.title: HTTP responses
panels.description: 2xx: success. 3xx: redirect. 4xx: invalid or rejected request. 5xx: server failure.

panels.title: Response latency · p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Estimated histogram percentiles for all selected requests, including failures. p50: median; p95/p99: slower tail. No requests means no estimate.

panels.title: Server error ratio · 5xx
panels.description: Server failures divided by all requests. Gaps mean no traffic, not 0% errors.

panels.title: Endpoints
panels.description: Instant snapshot for the selected endpoints. Latency is estimated from histogram buckets. A blank latency or error ratio means no requests in the last minute.

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (label_replace((sum by (route) (rate(capstone_http_requests_total{job="api",route=~"/v1/datasets/.+/metrics/${endpoint:raw}",status=~"5.."}[1m])) or (0 * sum by (route) (rate(capstone_http_requests_total{job="api",route=~"/v1/datasets/.+/metrics/${endpoint:raw}"}[1m])))) / (sum by (route) (rate(capstone_http_requests_total{job="api",route=~"/v1/datasets/.+/metrics/${endpoint:raw}"}[1m]))), "endpoint", "$1", "route", ".*/metrics/(.*)"))

panels.title: Cache · all three summary endpoints · not affected by endpoint filter
Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits / (hits + misses). Summary endpoints only; timeseries endpoints do not use the cache. No cache traffic means no ratio.

panels.title: Cache requests
panels.description: Combined hits and misses. refresh=true bypasses cache reads and is counted as a miss. Cache TTL: 30 seconds.

panels.title: Redis operation errors
panels.description: Failed Redis reads and writes. One request can fail both operations. The API falls back to ClickHouse. Zero is shown when cache metrics exist and no errors have been observed.

description: API request rate, errors and duration, with endpoint drill-down and service-wide cache diagnostics.
